title: Exosome isolation from plasma using ExoQuick reagent
protocol: Transfer 500 μL of plasma into a 1.5 mL microfuge tube.
Add 5 μL thrombin to a final concentration of 5U/mL.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes while mixing gently by flicking the tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 5 minutes.
Transfer supernatant to new microfuge tube.
Add 125 μL of ExoQuick Exosome Precipitation Solution to the plasma and incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Centrifuge ExoQuick/plasma mixture at 1,500 × g for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Spin down residual ExoQuick solution by centrifugation at 1,500 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Remove all traces of fluid by aspiration, taking great care not to disturb the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 50 μL sterile PBS and proceed with RNA isolation using SeraMir Exosome RNA Purification Column Kit.
